 Hi Matt,
 Thanks for the screenshots of the marriage record. Did you notice that the 1890 birth registration is for his son, Laurence? I don’t know what happened to him though. I can’t find any records that I know are
 absolutely him.
 I have no idea who Margaret McGrath is. Could be Mary Knight’s married sister or just a friend. I’m thinking she was just a friend. It’s interesting that Mary’s parents are not recorded, yet Laurence’s are. I
 wonder if the church record would show her parents. On her death certificate, her parents are recorded as James Knight and Bridget Larney. If you go on John Grenham’s website, Irish Ancestors, Larney is
 a very unusual Irish name and is found only in small pockets in various areas of Ireland. This is curious because one of the descendants of Theresa O’Reilly, Brittany Bepler has Mary Knight coming from
 County Sligo and the surname Courtney with her name, and yet no Larney-Knight marriages took place there. You may want to contact her and find out what she knows.

 As you can see from my family tree, Laurence b.1854 was married in Dublin. His wife and daughters all died except for Margaret Ester who went to the USA. One daughter, Anne born 1878 is a mystery. I
 can not find a death record for her or any other information on her. I don’t know if she died or emigrated or was adopted/ absorbed into another family. I’d like to find a death record and emigration record for
 Laurence but so far no luck.
 It’s interesting that Thomas Higgins’s wife was recorded as Mary on the 1880 census but her emigration record and death record have her as Bridget. Still can’t find his death record.Ancestry gives the FHL
 number for some records so I think I may have to go to a Mormon Family History centre to look them up.
 Yes, a lot of Irish emigration was through Liverpool. If they lived on the east side of Ireland, they would travel to Dublin, take a boat across to Liverpool and continue on to their final destination. I don’t know
 why England was written down on the ship’s manifest for Thomas and his family but I’m sure in many cases this type of error has caused problems for some family researchers. Fortunately, I knew it was an
 error because the children’s names matched what I had already researched.

  Megan Oglesby is from the Eustace family. She’s descended from Anne Eustace, younger sister of Jane Eustace Higgins. The rest I don’t know - kathi Gibb, Shawna Forkins, James Giblin, mike ranney,
